target_customer: Longevity clinics, neurology practices and consumers seeking early Alzheimer's risk screening via eye movement testing
problem: Alzheimer's testing happens around symptom onset. Eye movement changes may appear years earlier, and Saccade offers a 15 minute VR assessment with a headset attachment to capture them.
business_model: B2B to clinics for assessments plus a consumer wellness test and at home blood panel (pricing not found)
product_category: VR eye tracking diagnostic and wellness screening

founders.name: Shreyas Bhardwaj
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built medical devices for hospitals and was a soft robotics researcher; a UCSB capstone project page lists him as entrepreneur sponsor of the Saccade project, which won the People's Choice Award and 7,500 USD at the UCSB New Venture Competition. Organizations and degrees not stated.

competitors.name: Olleyes VR exam (UC Davis pilot)
competitors.what: VR eye exam piloted in a senior community to screen for vision changes linked to cognition

competitors.name: Max Planck Institute VR pupillometry trial
competitors.what: Recruiting trial using VR pupillometry and eye tracking for cognitive impairment

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs custom near infrared eye tracking hardware for headsets, ML risk models and clinical validation, none of which is published yet.

defensibility.rationale: Patent pending attachment and clinical data could compound, but there is no validation study and research groups pursue the same signal.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Searches for these incumbents returned nothing specific to 2026; no incumbent action recorded.

market_need_then: FDA approved Alzheimer's drugs in 2024 slow progression, which raises demand for earlier detection, per the company description.

branding.name_origin: A saccade is the rapid eye movement between fixation points; the name appears to refer to that term, but no source states the intent.
branding.domain_note: Uses saccade.health, not a .com. Several unrelated firms are named Saccade (Saccade Analytics, Saccade Diagnostics, Saccadous).

identity.logo: Logo mark, app icon and wordmark exist; design not described by sources
identity.visual_style: Calm, science led imagery with nature scene and clinician photos
identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct: Your best decisions need your best brain

brand_strength.rationale: A launch write-up on the Fondo blog exists, and the term fits the product, but similar names crowd search.

outcome_analysis: Saccade is a Fall 2026 YC company with one named founder offering a VR eye movement test. A Fondo article of October 2026 says it is in local clinics with no published validation or accuracy data, and the company calls the product investigational. It is too early for an outcome.
notes: Dealroom shows a 125k USD seed with no investors named; only one aggregator, so unverified and not recorded as a round. The YC page lists a team of 2 but names only one founder. Outcome search found only name collisions with other Saccade companies, excluded. The website also advertises an at home blood panel, a possible scope expansion beyond the YC description. Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (Dealroom); date and investors not given.
